mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic contraction.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of instances (or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates a slowdown in economic activity.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to stronger economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises (over a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates monetary tightening.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) signals a deepening economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 65% of instances (or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%), the S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a stable environment for equities.
failure_condition: In the regime defined by CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
